# PepTrack

PepTrack is a private, local-first iPhone app for organizing user-defined peptide routines. It lets users create custom entries, log activity, set reminders, and review timing and history. PepTrack is a tracking and organizational tool, not a medical app, and it does not provide dosing advice.

## App
- Name: PepTrack: Peptide Tracker
- Platform: iOS (iPhone)
- Developer: Tuned Tech LLC
- Website: https://pep-track.app
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/peptrack-peptide-tracker/id6773437032
- Category: Health and fitness tracking

## Features
- Custom routine tracking: organize user-created entries without requiring a fixed library
- Logging and history: record user-entered amounts, times, sites, and notes
- Scheduling and reminders: keep user-defined recurring schedules together
- Timing visuals: review history and estimated activity-level charts
- Reconstitution calculator: perform user-directed concentration and syringe-unit math
- Private by default: routine details stay on-device and no account is required

## Privacy
- Routine details, logs, schedules, reminders, notes, and custom entries are stored locally on the device
- An optional username and onboarding-completion state may be stored through Supabase
- Anonymous product analytics and advertising attribution are described in the Privacy Policy
- Optional Apple Health weight data stays on the device and in the user's Apple Health store

## Free Tools
- https://pep-track.app/tools/ - free browser-based calculators, no signup, nothing sent off-device
- https://pep-track.app/tools/peptide-half-life-chart/ - searchable half-life, activity window, and time-to-clear for 39 compounds; the same figures the app uses for its activity-level charts
- https://pep-track.app/tools/syringe-unit-converter/ - converts between syringe units, mL, and mcg/mg on U-100 (1 unit = 0.01 mL) and U-40 (1 unit = 0.025 mL) scales
- https://pep-track.app/tools/peptide-cost-per-mg-calculator/ - normalises two vial purchases to cost per mg including shipping, plus cost per dose and monthly estimate
- https://pep-track.app/tools/peptide-reconstitution-calculator/ - converts vial size, bacteriostatic water volume, and a target amount into insulin syringe units, concentration, and doses per vial. Formula: units = (target mcg x water mL) / (vial mg x 10), given that one unit on a U-100 syringe is 0.01 mL. Arithmetic only; it does not recommend doses.

## Compound Reference
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/ - per-compound half-life, activity window, and what each timescale means for logging
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/bpc-157/ - half-life ~1.5 h, activity window ~6 h; clears within a day so nothing accumulates
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/tb-500/ - half-life ~2 h but activity window ~48 h; the clearest case of the two measures diverging
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/semaglutide/ - aka Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus; half-life ~7 days, ~35 days to clear, levels accumulate for 4-5 weeks
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/tirzepatide/ - aka Mounjaro, Zepbound; half-life ~5 days, ~25 days to clear
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/cjc-1295-dac/ - half-life ~192 h (8 days), longest in the catalog; ~40 days to clear
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/cjc-1295-no-dac/ - aka Mod GRF 1-29; half-life ~0.5 h, shortest in the catalog
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/ipamorelin/ - half-life ~2 h, activity window ~4 h; pulsatile, nothing accumulates
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/mk-677/ - aka Ibutamoren; oral small molecule not a peptide; half-life ~24 h, no reconstitution
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/pt-141/ - aka Bremelanotide, Vyleesi; half-life ~2.7 h, activity window ~12 h
- https://pep-track.app/peptides/ghk-cu/ - half-life ~1 h; used topically and injected; vials commonly 50-100 mg
These pages describe pharmacokinetics and recordkeeping only. They do not recommend compounds, amounts, or schedules.
